snippet.title: The Incentive Program - Official Game Announcement Trailer (4K)
snippet.description:
FREE DEMO AVAILABLE NOW on Steam.  

The Incentive Program is a match-3 roguelike about a surreal corporate job that’s hiding something. You’re paid to play, but you won’t win. So rig the odds, exploit the rules, and escape the program.

https://www.theincentiveprogram.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=launchvideo
